tool_schemas.name: get_figma_data
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves structured context for a Figma file from an ingested snapshot, returning snapshot metadata plus the requested raw document and/or derived normalized context, and an optionally filtered/sorted node list paged with nodes_limit and nodes_cursor. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when figma_file_key is missing/invalid, snapshot_id is not a valid fsnap_ ULID, paging/sort values are out of range, or node_filters contains unsupported fields; raises NOT_FOUND when the file key does not exist or the specified snapshot_id is not found for that file. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not permitted to access the file/snapshot, and CONFLICT when no ready snapshot exists to serve (for example, ingestion is still in progress) and snapshot_id is omitted or refers to a non-ready snapshot.

figma_file_key.description: Figma file key to retrieve/sync metadata and structured context for.

snapshot_id.description: Specific snapshot ULID to fetch context from; if omitted, uses the latest ready snapshot.

include_raw_document.description: Whether to include the raw Figma document JSON in the response.

include_derived_context.description: Whether to include the derived/normalized context JSON in the response.

node_filters.description: Optional filters to narrow returned nodes from the snapshot graph.

node_types.description: Only include nodes whose type is in this list.

figma_node_ids.description: Only include nodes matching these Figma node IDs.

parent_figma_node_id.description: Only include nodes whose parent Figma node ID matches this value.

renderable_only.description: If true, only return nodes marked renderable.

visible_only.description: If true, only return nodes marked visible.

text_search.description: Case-insensitive substring search over node name and text content.

nodes_limit.description: Maximum number of nodes to return.

tool_schemas.name: download_figma_images
tool_schemas.description: Creates a render job for the given figma_node_ids (or, if render_job_id is provided, returns the status and any available assets for that existing job) and returns rendered asset records and download URLs, paged with assets_limit and assets_cursor; when wait_for_completion is true, the call blocks until the job completes or can return a terminal failure. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when requested formats are empty/invalid, figma_node_ids is empty, scale is out of range, snapshot_id/render_job_id do not match required patterns, or pagination values are out of range; raises NOT_FOUND when the file key, snapshot, render job, or any requested node ID is not present in the selected snapshot. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the caller cannot access the file/snapshot/job, and CONFLICT when the snapshot is not ready for rendering, the render job cannot transition to a downloadable state (e.g., still processing without wait_for_completion), or the provided render_job_id does not belong to the specified figma_file_key/snapshot context.

figma_file_key.description: Figma file key containing the nodes to render/download.

snapshot_id.description: Snapshot ULID to render against; if omitted, uses the latest ready snapshot.

figma_node_ids.description: List of Figma node IDs to render (typically IMAGE/ICON/VECTOR/etc.).

formats.description: Image formats to render for each requested node.

scale.description: Render scale factor applied to the exported images.

use_absolute_bounds.description: Whether to export using absolute bounds rather than node bounds.

render_job_id.description: Existing render job ULID to poll/download assets for instead of creating a new job.

wait_for_completion.description: If true, waits for render job completion and returns assets when available.

assets_limit.description: Maximum number of rendered assets to return.

assets_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for paginating rendered assets.

tool_schemas.name: list_figma_files
tool_schemas.description: Lists ingested Figma files visible to the caller, with optional filtering by team/project/key and status. Returns paged results. Refuses requests with invalid filters or pagination values (VALIDATION_ERROR).

team_id.description: Only return files belonging to this Figma team ID.

project_id.description: Only return files belonging to this Figma project ID.

figma_file_key.description: Only return the file matching this Figma file key.

status.description: Only return files whose status is in this list.

limit.description: Maximum number of files to return.

tool_schemas.name: upsert_figma_file
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new ingested Figma file record or updates an existing one by figma_file_key. Returns the resulting figma_files row. Refuses creation/updates when required identifiers are missing, when status is invalid, or when attempting to unarchive an archived file (VALIDATION_ERROR).

figma_file_key.description: Figma file key to create or update.

name.description: Human-readable file name (may be set/updated from upstream).

team_id.description: Figma team ID the file belongs to.

project_id.description: Figma project ID the file belongs to.

status.description: Lifecycle status for the file. Transition rules apply when changing an existing file.

auth_context_id.description: Reference to the auth context used for upstream Figma access (when applicable).

last_error.description: Last recorded error message, typically set when status='error'.

tool_schemas.name: update_figma_file_status
tool_schemas.description: Transitions a figma_files row to a new status according to lifecycle rules (e.g., active->needs_auth). Returns the updated figma_files row. Refuses invalid transitions or attempts to create new work for archived files (VALIDATION_ERROR).

last_error.description: Optional error details when transitioning into status='error'.

tool_schemas.name: create_figma_file_snapshot
tool_schemas.description: Queues a new snapshot build for a Figma file, creating a figma_file_snapshots row with status='queued'. Returns the created snapshot record. Refuses when the file is archived or needs_auth, when the file cannot be found, or when inputs are invalid (VALIDATION_ERROR / AUTHORIZATION_ERROR).

figma_file_key.description: Figma file key to build a new snapshot for.

figma_file_id.description: Internal figma_files ULID to build a new snapshot for (alternative to figma_file_key).

figma_version.description: Optional Figma version hint to record for this snapshot build.

force_rebuild.description: If true, queues a new snapshot even if a ready snapshot exists.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def create_figma_file_snapshot(figma_file_key=None, figma_file_id=None, figma_version=None, force_rebuild=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re, time, random

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0514000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0514000") else "/app/database")

    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []

    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    def _log(endpoint, status_code, latency_ms, detail=None):
        logs_name_candidates = [
            "request_logs.json",
            "usage_logs.json",
            "audit_logs.json",
            "api_requests.json",
        ]
        existing = None
        for fn in logs_name_candidates:
            if os.path.exists(os.path.join(_DB, fn)):
                existing = fn
                break
        if not existing:
            return
        logs = _load(existing)
        now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
        row = {
            "id": f"req_{int(time.time()*1000)}",
            "endpoint": endpoint,
            "status": status_code,
            "latency_ms": latency_ms,
            "timestamp": now,
        }
        if detail is not None:
            row["detail"] = detail
        logs.append(row)
        _save(existing, logs)

    # ULID-ish generator (not full spec): monotonic timestamp + Crockford base32.
    _CROCK = "0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ"

    def _new_id(prefix):
        ms = int(time.time() * 1000)
        rnd = random.getrandbits(80)
        v = (ms << 80) | rnd
        s = []
        for _ in range(26):
            s.append(_CROCK[v & 31])
            v >>= 5
        return f"{prefix}_" + "".join(reversed(s))

    t0 = time.time()

    try:
        if figma_file_key is None and figma_file_id is None:
            out = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Either figma_file_key or figma_file_id is required.")
            _log("create_figma_file_snapshot", "VALIDATION_ERROR", int((time.time() - t0) * 1000), out["error"])
            return out

        if figma_file_key is not None and not isinstance(figma_file_key, str):
            out = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "figma_file_key must be a string.")
            _log("create_figma_file_snapshot", "VALIDATION_ERROR", int((time.time() - t0) * 1000), out["error"])
            return out

        if figma_file_id is not None:
            if not isinstance(figma_file_id, str) or not re.match(r"^ffile_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{10,}$", figma_file_id):
                out = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "figma_file_id is invalid.")
                _log("create_figma_file_snapshot", "VALIDATION_ERROR", int((time.time() - t0) * 1000), out["error"])
                return out

        if figma_version is not None and not isinstance(figma_version, str):
            out = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "figma_version must be a string when provided.")
            _log("create_figma_file_snapshot", "VALIDATION_ERROR", int((time.time() - t0) * 1000), out["error"])
            return out

        if force_rebuild is not None and not isinstance(force_rebuild, bool):
            out = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "force_rebuild must be a boolean when provided.")
            _log("create_figma_file_snapshot", "VALIDATION_ERROR", int((time.time() - t0) * 1000), out["error"])
            return out

        files = _load("figma_files.json")
        file_row = None
        if figma_file_id is not None:
            file_row = next((r for r in files if r.get("id") == figma_file_id), None)
        else:
            file_row = next((r for r in files if r.get("figma_file_key") == figma_file_key), None)

        if not file_row:
            out = _err("NOT_FOUND", "figma file not found.")
            _log("create_figma_file_snapshot", "NOT_FOUND", int((time.time() - t0) * 1000), out["error"])
            return out

        # Authorization/business rules: needs_auth or archived prevent new work
        if file_row.get("status") == "needs_auth":
            out = _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Figma file requires re-authentication before snapshots can be created.")
            _log("create_figma_file_snapshot", "UNAUTHORIZED", int((time.time() - t0) * 1000), out["error"])
            return out

        if file_row.get("status") == "archived":
            out = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Cannot create snapshots for archived figma files.")
            _log("create_figma_file_snapshot", "VALIDATION_ERROR", int((time.time() - t0) * 1000), out["error"])
            return out

        snapshots = _load("figma_file_snapshots.json")
        ffid = file_row.get("id")

        # If not forcing rebuild, and a ready snapshot exists, return the most recent ready snapshot idempotently.
        if not force_rebuild:
            ready = [s for s in snapshots if s.get("figma_file_id") == ffid and s.get("status") == "ready"]
            if ready:
                def _dt(v):
                    return v or ""
                ready.sort(key=lambda r: _dt(r.get("build_completed_at")) or _dt(r.get("updated_at")) or _dt(r.get("created_at")), reverse=True)
                out = {"snapshot": ready[0], "reused": True}
                _log("create_figma_file_snapshot", "OK", int((time.time() - t0) * 1000))
                return out

        now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
        snap = {
            "id": _new_id("fsnap"),
            "figma_file_id": ffid,
            "figma_version": figma_version,
            "document_etag": None,
            "raw_document": None,
            "derived_context": None,
            "node_count": 0,
            "status": "queued",
            "build_started_at": None,
            "build_completed_at": None,
            "error": None,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now,
        }

        # FK integrity: ensure parent exists already (it does) and id unique
        if any(s.get("id") == snap["id"] for s in snapshots):
            # extremely unlikely, but handle deterministically
            snap["id"] = _new_id("fsnap")

        snapshots.append(snap)
        _save("figma_file_snapshots.json", snapshots)

        out = {"snapshot": snap, "reused": False}
        _log("create_figma_file_snapshot", "OK", int((time.time() - t0) * 1000))
        return out
    except Exception as e:
        out = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Unexpected server error.", detail=str(e))
        _log("create_figma_file_snapshot", "VALIDATION_ERROR", int((time.time() - t0) * 1000), out["error"])
        return out

tool_schemas.name: list_figma_file_snapshots
tool_schemas.description: Lists snapshots for a Figma file with optional filtering by status. Returns paged results. Refuses invalid ids, filters, or pagination values (VALIDATION_ERROR).

figma_file_key.description: Figma file key whose snapshots should be listed.

figma_file_id.description: Internal figma_files ULID whose snapshots should be listed (alternative to figma_file_key).

status.description: Only return snapshots whose status is in this list.

limit.description: Maximum number of snapshots to return.

metadata.name: Framelink Figma MCP
metadata.description: This backend stores ingested Figma file metadata and a node graph snapshot so clients can retrieve structured context (frames, components, text, styles) and download rendered assets (SVG/PNG) for specific nodes. Main workflows: (1) ingest/sync a Figma file into a normalized snapshot; (2) request ima
